lcc_original: 放了一隻烏鴉出去。烏鴉出去，飛來飛去，直到水在地上都乾了。
notes: 放了...出去: SN <WH07971><WTH8762> attaches to 放了 (the main sending verb); the directional complement 出去 has no separate Hebrew equivalent (it is absorbed into שָׁלַח).
Second clause 烏鴉出去: LCC uses 出去 where UNV uses 飛來 for the main וַיֵּצֵא (H03318, Qal impf); both express the raven's departure.

Hebrew idiom יָצוֹא וָשׁוֹב (going out and returning) → LCC 飛來飛去: 飛來 carries the cognate inf abs <WH03318><WTH8800>; 飛去 carries the שׁוּב <WH07725><WTH8800>. Since LCC has an explicit 飛去 for the implicit {<WH07725>}, braces dropped per Rule 3.
Word order inversion: UNV 地上的水 → LCC 水在地上; tags redistributed so 水<WH04325> precedes 在地<WH0776>上<WAH04480><WAH05921>.
